nom: cocokind Peptide Fine Line Eye Gel

avis.texte: Previously was using a $100 eye cream. Bought this on a whim because I thought it could replace undereye corrector (pink tint) for no makeup days. While it does provide minimal correction and brightening, the real benefit is the hydration and firming! Plays well with every product, and works just as well as my more expensive eye creams. Will continue to purchase as long as they make it.
Love how light weight this feels. I use it morning and night. I love using the Cocokind under eye patches in the mornings to get even more hydration.
Such a nice daytime gel eye cream. It sinks into the skin fast and has a nice hygienic pump. It does not irritate the sensitive skin around my eyes.

avis.titre: Lightweight eye cream for soothing and appearance of fine li
avis.texte: This eye cream is great for soothing under the eyes and fine lines. It won't reverse aging, but will slow it down! Lightweight and can easily layer under other skin care or makeup. I use this everyday to help fine lines and provide some hydration for the under eyes.

The cocokind peptide fine line eye gel really helped with the minor fine lines and dryness around my eyes. After using it consistently for a few weeks, my under-eye area looked smoother, more hydrated, and less crepey. It didn't completely transform my under-eyes overnight, but I definitely noticed they looked softer and more refreshed. I also loved the packaging. The pump makes it really easy to control how much product comes out, and one pump is enough for both eyes, so it doesn't feel wasteful. I appreciate that it dispenses just the right amount and keeps the product easy and mess-free to use every day.
I really like this stuff, and the bottle is super cute. Warning- if you have sensitive skin, this will burn! but overall i like it.
Please dont ever discontinue this!!! I can see such a difference in my fine lines/overall texture of my under eyes since Ive started using this consistently. It wears well under makeup too!
I feel like this kind of works? I cant really tell. It seems like the effects dont last if youre not using it every other day. I had better results with eye retinols than this cream.
Great eye cream - love the peptides for the fine lines. Leaves my eye area hydrated without feeling weighed down or messing with my makeup!

I'm a longtime lover of Cocokind's other eye cream, and when this one came out I was psyched to have the same effective magic with brightening reflects. Unfortunately, this didn't work for me- it burned immediately. I gave it a few more tries just in case, but something in this didn't work for my skin. Back to the blue tube!

I love this eye cream! It feels refreshing, brightens my under eyes and smooths my fine lines. It wears well under concealer, even my guy friend noticed that my under eyes looked less dark! I use this in the am and pm. Wish this was more hyped because it works. Its not immediate results, but good things take time :). I did see someone mention issues with packaging. The pump is short so when youre almost done with it there is still a bit left but hard to get out, I dont mind it as much cause i still manage to get most of it out. I did see a TikTok in which the owner mentions the reason why it doesnt have a metal applicator like their other eye cream is because it would cost more. So I am ok with this packaging. The price is not too high.
This product did nothing for me. It says it's for fine lines, but I actually feel like it accentuated them.

avis.titre: Its versatile and plays well with make up!
avis.texte: Ive used several tubes and have been pleased. It wears well under makeup and seems to soften the crinkle lines I have. Ive had them my whole life, but I notice them a lot less when I regularly use this cream. Bonus, peptides are great for around your mouth too!

I really love this product, but really dislike the packaging. The pump mechanism is clunky and wastes so much product when you're close to finishing it. I really wish they would put this formula into a similar packaging as their hydrating eye cream! The frustration with the packaging makes me consider not re-buying.

avis.titre: Not a miracle worker but I will buy again
avis.texte: I haven't noticed a huge difference to be honest but it feels moisturizing and it has sheer pink coverage that brightens up the under eye. I much prefer this over a concealer any day better results and doesn't sink into fine lines.
Don't think it does much for me. Also can irritate my skin when I use it when my skin is really dry.

avis.titre: This + chlorophyll disco. serum are the answer
avis.texte: Ive been using this for a few months now and I am loving it! I have absolutely noticed a difference in the discoloration (I also use the chlorophyll discoloration serum and bring it up to my eyes). Its definitely helped the fine lines and eventually Ill be able to try one of Cocokinds retinols and Ill be intrigued to watch the deeper lines fade away!
Please never discontinue this eye cream. I love it so much!!!! Its the only eye cream I've tried where it didnt give me milia or a weird reaction. Concealer applies so nice after using as well

avis.titre: Great formula, but major packaging issues
avis.texte: Ill start by saying: I do really love the formula of this eye cream it looks great, it goes on so smooth and melts into my skin. I use it in the AM since it gives a bit more coverage than the Revitalizing Eye Cream, which I use at night. All that said, Ive had enough recurring issues with the packaging that I may stop using it altogether! The lid cracks each time, just from typical use of putting it gently on the counter. And excess product gets all over the pump, which is sadly a waste. Oddly enough I think its the same pump mechanism used for the Electrolyte Water Cream, which is phenomenal in that product. I thought it was a fluke at first, but Ive had the same issues happen three times now. Id really love to see this formula available with different or updated packaging!

This eye cream is soothing and moisturizing. I feel like a brightens a little bit as well. I am starting to get a few smile lines, and this works well to plump those areas back up. I am taking off one star because at times it seems to migrate a bit into my eyes which is not great with contacts.
This gel truly does what it says. My fine lines are almost invisible. Sits well under primer. I'm in love with it.
I just started using this product and I can see some improvements ,lessening the wrinkles and fine lines around my eyes.Thus I will continue to use it because it is giving me a promising result.
I love this eye cream especially around the eyelids since I have extremely dry eyelids. The cream is very nourishing.
The first time I swiped this on I saw magic!! I swear it wiped lines right away, incredible!
I love this simple, unscented eye cream. It's easy to apply and is lightweight yet moisturizing!
Love that this is an eyecream that targets my fine lines and prevents them.

New favorite eye cream! The gel like light texture of this eye cream absorbs so smoothly and is awesome under makeup! I use this one every morning and then the thicker eye cream at night for deeper hydration.

I've been using cocokind for 5 years so I'm always excited when a new product drops and this has been an amazing addition to the line! I don't always like under eye cream but this is soothing and dries nicely
Instantly fixes fine lines and plumps up the area around the eyes. Fuss-free and plays well with other products. This is a great product at a even better price point!
Im cant believe I waited so long to try this product. I love the thin texture and the pink tint, I think it helps with minimal discoloration

It does help with puffiness and give brightness for your under eye. Back to the lab because it causes irrtation to the eye. It also caused my eyelashes to fall out!! This product can not cause that kind of cons.
First off, this is more of a gel-cream than a gel. Its not that hydrating and really stings my eyes. I end up wiping it off a lot.

I love this product !!! Not only is it great for under my eyes, but I also use it on my smile lines, and my forehead! I ve found it to help lessen the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles. I also use this product with the reusable eye patches!! Overall, it s such a great eye serum but I love that I can use it on other parts of my face!

she s underrated & deserves way more attention! i love the little pump applicator, the tint is beautiful & helps reduce the look of under eye darkness, and i swear after using it for quite a while "i ve been seeing REAL results. my under eye area is more plump, smoother & just looks so healthier. when i first started using it, i d been alternating between a couple eye products, but quickly shifted to only using this after loving the initial application & wanted to test the formula + results. i m happy to say this one is so, so solid!!!! i d recommend this to anyone with fine lines around the eye, darkness that needs a little brightening up, and/or anyone trying to plump up the under eye area. this is amazing & so, so worth a try if you haven t already!!

avis.titre: You won t regret buying this!!
avis.texte: This is the first eye cream I have wanted to use consistently. It s the perfect combination of lightweight yet hydrating. I love the pink tint and the incredible ingredients for anti-aging.
I will forever get this because its the only thing so far that has not given me milia around my eyes.

avis.titre: She may be small, but she puts in the WORK!
avis.texte: This eye gel is one of my holy grail products! I love the thinner, serum-like consistency for daytime. I notice a huge difference in the look of my under eye area after using this since it launched. Its noticeably brighter, firmer, and smoother, which I appreciate as my skin is changing with age.

avis.titre: I am definitely buying this again
avis.texte: So far I have loved this eye cream. It's been one of my favorites to use
Ive been looking for a loghtweight yet hydrating eye cream & this has done just that. It looks good under makeup & my under eyes look less dry. Found a new staple!
the formula is just thin enough to hydrate while also sitting well under my makeup! great for wrinkle prevention < 3

now that i'm in my 30s i'm starting to notice my makeup doesn't look as seamless if i don't have solid moisturizer on underneath! i do this often before concealer so that the concealer does not seep into my fine lines and also it gives it an extra glow !
I love how lightweight this gel is without feeling greasy or too gel-y. It goes on my skin soo nicely. I use it every morning!
Love this product! I love using this and laying my cocokind under eye mask on, it really plumps up under my eyes.

I loveee this eye gel!! Over the past few months Ive noticed that my under eye area continues to look and feel hydrated and happy. Other eye gels sting and leave my eyes looking red - this one does not.

avis.titre: Love this eye gel in my nighttime routine!
avis.texte: I've been loving the way this product feels on my under eye. I've been using this at night, sometimes paired with the reusable eye patches and I'm loving the revitalizing eye cream in the mornings to help wake up my eye area. It's a great combo!
A fantastic eye gel for fine lines and really smooths out the under eye and works great under makeup!

I bought this about two weeks ago, so I cant say if my lines have diminished yet, however, the consistency of this eye cream is great. The pink color helps with darkness and brightens the undereye area. I love the feel of it, it's so hydrating and doesnt sting or irritate my eyes (I have oily skin but dry undereyes). I would definitely recommend this product!

So i actually used this on my neck wrinkles, not on my eyes. But so far, it seems to have helped a little bit. Consistency seems to be key. Seems like you need to use it every day. It definitely isnt a "miracle" product, it wont completely erase wrinkles, but for me, it did make them slightly less noticeable / prominent, so that was nice. I would say for that result, the price is a little high for me, so thats why i didnt give it 5 stars. I would probably switch to something else once this runs out (hopefully something that can work better?)
I found it absorbs easily. Nicely brightens my eyes does a great job without burning a hole in the wallet. Im 38 and this does great to improve and keep at bay. Use this religiously.

avis.titre: Unbeatable performance for the price point!
avis.texte: I got this product when I started to notice fine lines around my eyes (30 is coming for me and I am not okay) but could bring myself to shell out the kind of money needed for most of the products that came with the highest recommendations. After just under 2 months of daily use, with well over half the product remaining, I decided to do a side by side comparison and I was BLOWN AWAY. I can't believe how much of a difference I see in the fine lines around my eyes. I was kind of convinced all firming skincare was a gimmick and only fillers would fix my wrinkles one day, so I can't believe the results I got. And for this price point?? Absolutely unbelievable and unbeatable. I currently use this product 2x a day, once in the morning and once in the evening. I apply it after my serums but before my moisturizer.

avis.titre: I'm 48 and I use it religiously
avis.texte: Look, I am 48. I tend to invest in the more serious (read $$) anti-aging skincare products, but I crossover to cocokind for this product because it works that well. I keep one in my bag and dab it on my eye area all day while using serious actives at night. Better day eye cream than StriVectin and Perricone. I'm serious.

Wonderful formula! My only issue is I wish it came with the metal tip-even if it cost a few dollars more to have it. Even so, I use both eye creams and both are amazing. Definitely recommend this one for those like me-in their 30's and up.
wanted to like the product but it gave me a chemical burn around my eyes and eyelids

avis.titre: Less Fine Lines & No Longer Tired Looking
avis.texte: Been using this eye cream since the product was released. Once a week I pair this with the cocokind reusable eye patches. Since adding this to my routine my eyes look brighter and my wrinkles appear less noticeable. When paired with the reusable eye patches I look 100x more awake, which is saying a ton when I have 2 kids under 2 that don't sleep through the night!

I only started using the peptide fine line gel for about 1 month and only at night. I am amazed at how little I have to use to make a difference in the appearance of the skin under my eye. I routinely have very little puffines but the skin is smooth and just looks refreshed ! I love it.

I've been using this eye gel for a few months now and I can confidently say I love it! I like the thinner consistency and how it absorbs very nicely. I can't say that I've seen much visual improvement, but I can say my under-eyes feel hydrated and smoother. It sits nicely under my sunscreen as well as my makeup, which I cannot say for every eye product in my collection! And I've had no rash or adverse reactions to this product. Adding another tube to my cart right now!!
I've been using this for like a year now and it is so good!!! Really does brighten under the eyes & helps fine lines.

I typically don't leave reviews, but I have to for this product because its THAT good! I struggle with fine lines under my eyes that my makeup settles into, and dark circles. I've tried multiple under eye products, and this is the best one by far. I use it in the morning before makeup and my undereyes are bright with minimal creasing! (I'm still working on perfecting the creasing situation) But I highly recommend this eye cream!

As someone who's 28 and is starting to notice beautiful smile lines forming, I've added this eye gel into my routine to help on days I may want a little extra support under and around my eyes before wearing makeup or to just give myself a little boost of confidence!!
I liked this at first, but after about a week of use it has caused a red spots under my eyes, some discoloration and stings

Love this for under my makeup or no makeup days. I can get bumps under my eye when an eye cream is too heavy, so this is perfectly light and adds the right amount of hydration before concealer. I also think the slight pink tone helps color correct justtttt a little on no makeup days!

I blindly bought this as I was looking for an eye cream that could maybe help with the creasing and settling I experienced with my concealer. Now obviously the creasing did not magically disappear because my eye does have natural creases but it helped so much with settling and smoothing the concealer. I have no stopped using it since I bought it (a week) I think if you were looking at any expensive eye cream to help with wrinkles under makeup, you should take this one into consideration because I was very impressed by it.

I am really enjoying this step to my evening routine. I put it on and use the reusable eye masks while I read before bed. It's a nice relaxing process and makes my eyes feel extra hydrated. Especially when I'm using the retinol gel!

After trying the Revitalizing eye cream with not much change, I tried the fine line gel and have great success! The crows feet are minimizing, the small lines under my eyes are disappearing and overall the area I've been putting the gel on just seems brighter. A big fan of this eye gel so I highly recommend for anyone dealing with lines around the eye area!

I love cocokind and the revitalizing eye cream, so I wanted to give this a try. It burned the skin around my eyes and left it red and bumpy. Looked like i had a horrible sunburn. Do yourself a favor and buy the revitalizing eye cream instead

I have really been enjoying this new product in my routine! I have definitely noticed an improvement on my crows feet and other fine lines around my eye area, and my skin is more hydrated. I will be using this long term!

This is a great morning moisturizer for my eyes. I love how lightweight it feels, and how seamlessly it sits under my makeup. I'm definitely at the age where I need all the help with fine lines, so I love that this product is designed for that
I really enjoy this product! I love how it feels light and delicate, just like the area I'm gently placing it on to. It's got a luxurious feel to it, I really enjoy!
This eye cream is absolutely fantastic! I use it every morning in my skincare routine and it leaves my eye area feeling glowy and hydrated! I highly recommend!
This gel eye cream paired with the reusable eye patches is the best!!!! My under eyes are noticeably brighter after one use.

I have been absolutely loving this eye cream! Finally an affordable eye cream that actually works to hydrate, brighten and smooth out fine lines. Peptides are one of my favorite ingredients and they work so well in this formula! The slight pink tint helps illuminate and brighten the under eyes. This has become a quick staple for morning and night for me!

This is the first time I've ever written a review but I can't help but GUSH about this brand to anyone who gives me an ear. I have extreme fine lines and have been using this product for about a month. I have seen my skin look firmer, I haven't noticed a change in the lines primarily because I'm just one very expressive gal but I'm going to continue using this product every night before bed! Love the ingredients and how soothing and gentle this is on my skin. 10/10!

This quickly became one of my favorite new products in 2025! I use this daily in am and pm. It sits nicely under makeup and leave my eye area feeling hydrated and plump. The pink packaging makes it even better!
I have reactive skin and my skin broke out around my eyes bad
I thought this would be great, but it broke me out in a rash around me eyes pretty bad.
Honestly just the best, started using it 2 months ago and it's one of the best I've ever used. Helps with both puffiness and darkness. Recommended to friends already!
This eye cream is amazing! It blends in so easily, quickly, and with the perfect texture. The pink tint significantly helps with my dark circles, and I love knowing I am getting powerful peptides!
This has been such a game changer for me! I use in the morning and the hydration it provides is amazing.

I am extremely disappointed with the results. Despite using it consistently, I noticed no improvement in my under-eye area, nor did it provide any hydration. It didn't help with my fine lines at all. In fact, I experienced a burning sensation upon application, followed by the development of small red bumps around my eyes. Given the price, I was expecting much better results.

Ugh. I wanted to love this product so bad (and have given it multiple tries), but unfortunately it continues to make me have a lot of redness and causes a bit of a burning sensation. I think it's a me thing, not a product thing though, just something to be aware of! Will continue to use the revitalizing eye cream :)
I can see a big difference with this product in a short period. It's really light and has a subtle light/shimmer that's beautiful. Can't wait to keep using it and see the results.

My first time using eye creams/gels and I got both of cocokind's options to use in the morning and night. I didn't think I would notice the difference so much! But a lot less puffy and I look a lot less tired overall. I tend to get pretty dark shadows/bags under my eyes and that hasn't completely gone away (not sure if it can) but there is a difference!
I love using this in the morning. Light, refreshing and brightening

The ingredients looked great and I loved the luminous finish with that very subtle pink tint! Unfortunately, the formula caused my eyes to turn red, water, and sting all day and night anytime I applied it. I gave it a try for a few days thinking maybe it was just allergies or something but the day I stopped using it the burning and tears stopped immediately. Still giving 3 stars because the formula felt nice, my eyes just happened to hate it. Too bad, will have to return!
Best peptide eye cream. Works wonders overnight and is a great price point. Highly recommend pairing with the revitalizing eye cream in the mornings!
I absolutely love this product. I have been using for about 2-3 months and I noticed my crow's feet are less noticeable
I like this product a lot but it does sting a bit for those with sensitive skin (like me). It does help with fine lines though!

avis.titre: Nice but not great with makeup
avis.texte: The cream itself is really nice and feels good but I'm noticing that it does not look good with makeup over it. I usually don't get creased concealer but I now do since using this.
I noticed a difference within a week. My under eyes don't look as dark or sunken in. Love it.

This eye gel feels like makeup with all of the benefits of skincare! I've had a rough few months and it's been showing through bags under my eyes. This gel instantly brightened and hydrated under my eyes making me look well rested.

I already use cocokindâ€™s Revitalizing Eye Cream but found it pilled with some of my under eye makeup products. There are no such issues with this cream, making it a great part of my morning routine!
I started use this product and started noticing a difference in a few weeks once I started using it twice a day. I will definitely be using this other the other eye products I have

Very disappointed in this product. I wanted to try this eye cream because i was already a fan of their eye cream that comes in the blue bottle, but this one literally burned my eye lids. My eyes have red raised patches over them. Wouldn't recommend.

This is the first eye cream I use and overall its pretty good. Ive been using it for a month & I dont see much of a difference with the fine lines, maybe just a tad smoother. It also helped my bottom lashes grow which idk why it did but not complaining!

avis.titre: Great eye treatment for sensitive eyes!
avis.texte: Great eye treatment for sensitive eyes! I have been trying to find an eye treatment that doesn't bother my eyes forever, but the hunt is finally over with this amazing pink tube. There is no scent or harsh chemicals, and I love how it makes my eye area smooth and awaken gently yet effectively. Thank you very much for making such a wonderful product!

avis.titre: Instant pick me up for eyes
avis.texte: I can't believe I found this product! If I hadn't seen it recommended, I never would have bought it because my mature skin needs a serious product and the price would have led me to assume this wouldn't cut the mustard. A completely false assumption! I keep this with me during the day in my bag and every time I notice my eyes are looking a little dry or dark, I pat some on and it's an instant brightener and smoother. For the money, you really can afford to put it on throughout the day. Will definitely be trying other Cocokind products.
I love the texture. The pink tube is super cute but it's hard to pump without the bottom poking the palm of your hand

I have only been using this product for a few days now and have seen a difference in my undereyes. I bought it to replace my old Mary Kay eye cream. I like to apply it right before I got to bed along with my nightly moisturizer. I wake up with less dark circles and a highly moisturized undereye. It brightens and decreases my fine lines. I love this product. The only thing I wish was different was the tube just has a pump and no applicator. I prefer to have a built in applicator.

I am on the spectrum and precise product output means a lot to me because, otherwise, I have to talk myself out of not freaking out. My beauty products need to have a pump or they need to be easy for me to evenly count. I think in numbers. I love the slight tingle of the product. I love that it layers well. Keep up the good work!
Light yet hydrating. So gentle and feels really nice on the skin. I am in love with everything I've tried from this brand. It has been excellent!
Feels good on! I have sensitive skin and this product has been absolutely fine.
This is a great under eye for daily use with foundation. Goes on smooth & creamy. Dries excellent so it's easy to layer on top of

I decided to try this eye cream for fun when I saw it come out, as I normally buy the revitalizing eye cream (which I also love) in the blue tube. My first impression is that I love the pump applicator as opposed to the squeeze tube of the other eye cream, as I found the other one hard to dispense product as you near the end of the tube. I also love the gel-like consistency of the product as opposed to the thicker creamy consistency of the other one, and I find it applies like a dream, and absorbs quickly. I do feel like it reduced the look of fine lines at the corners of my eye and helps my concealer apply smoothly. I will definitely repurchase.
Love this eye gel! My eye area is very sensitive so many products irritate my skin. Happily, this product does not! It leaves my eye area well hydrated. Kudos to Cocokind!
One of my new favourite eye gels. It's so light weight in texture and it feels so airy around the eyes. It immediately feels so hydrating and absorbs so nicely into the skin. I love it!

Unfortunately I had an adverse reaction to this product. Love the texture of it, and it felt great on my eyes until I developed a bit of an allergic reaction. Left my eyes puffy and itchy all day. I've made several attempts with this product to ensure it really is the cause of the reaction, and unfortunately it is. I'll stick to the Revitalizing Eye Cream, which works much better with my skin - no issues with that product!

avis.titre: Nice to try, hydrating and glistening
avis.texte: This was hydrating and it definitely was brightening in the sense that there was a subtle glisten. I liked that I could better control how much product I pumped out. I'm not sure it had much of an effect on fine lines, and I definitely prefer the other eye cream to help with dark circles, so I will probably stick with the blue tube. I found his had a similar effect to another clean brand's eye gel that shall remain unnamed which might be cheaper.

avis.titre: Great for undereyes and gentle on eczema!
avis.texte: This gel is a really great eye moisturizer and has made an impact on my undereye circles. I have eczema on my eyes and this gel doesn't irritate it which is great! I have used this in rotation with a retinol eye balm and got really good results on reducing purple tones in my under eyes and fine lines. I would recommend! I will be trying it with the eye cream next.

This product was so easy to use. It always leaves my eye area looking very glowy and hydrated which I love. It also has a very low barrier to entry because its so easy to use and incorporate into a routine!

New fave! It definitely adds a little illumination/glow to the under eyes which Im loving! Blends well with the other products I use with it & my makeup! ðŸ˜Š Added it in my routine just in the AM right now since I use the revitalizing eye cream in PM: Chlorophyl Discoloration serum Ceramide Barrier Serum Peptide Eye Gel Sunscreen

The pink color of this product is soo cute & fun. I've only been using the cream for a few weeks but I do feel like I have seen a small improvement in the lines on the outside of my eyes. I'm looking forward to seeing what happens as I continue to use the product.
Great addition to my routine! I see improvements in my eye area already

I am giving this 4 stars because I do think its a little less moisturizing than the revitalizing eye cream. I have only been using it a few weeks consistently so I want to use it a little longer before deciding my final thoughts. My skin is very dry so I put a little eye cream on first, then top it with peptide gel and that seems to help a lot. It does brighten upon application but I havent noticed a huge difference in how smooth my under eye is. Will report back!

I don't have a product that I regularly use or have repurchased in the past for my eyes because my eye area is the last thing I ever notice any product having any effect on, but this peptide cream actually has instant visible effects. I have dark circles and although I don't see that this product has reduced darkness in my under eye area after using for a week and half, I can tell that it helps a lot with brightening and helping my eyes look less puffy and more awake especially in the morning immediately after putting this on during my morning routine.

avis.titre: Immediately adding this to my lineup!
avis.texte: I absolutely loved this product! The consistency was very smooth and lightweight, perfect for a daytime eye product. It melted into my skin, without leaving residue and layered really well with my makeup products. I definitely noticed the brightening effects that the subtle tint provided. Overall, Im really happy with the results and Ill be adding this product to my lineup!
Lightweight gel formula feels great on the skin! Helps reduce the appearance of dark circles. Absorbs quickly and does not leave a film. Moisturizing to the eye area.

What a great eye product! The texture is soft and smooth. It is so easy to apply. The color is a soft pink hue that blends into skin so nicely and gives a nice subtle brightening effect. I did not observe any creasing from using this product. This product layers nicely with other products. Each day I used this, my eye area appeared bright and smooth.

avis.titre: Brightening eye cream with fine line smoothing benefits
avis.texte: If you're looking for a lightweight, hydrating eye cream to use during the day, look no further! I've found that this eye cream effectively brightens my under-eye area with its subtle pink hue and pearl finish while hydrating my tired eyes. The added benefit of smoothing fine lines is a great bonus.
Very excited for this one! Very light, very pretty , very melts into the skin ðŸ¤

avis.titre: The best eye cream Ive ever used!!!
avis.texte: I love it!!! The texture is silky and it brightens up my eyes without feeling heavy. The best part is you can wear it under makeup and it looks so natural. So excited for this product!!!
It definitely hydrates my eye area and I love the neutral light shade of pink because it brightens my under eye area
